title: Recruit Copilot experience bank
description: The single source of truth for every generated resume. Every claim here must be true and confirmable by the candidate.

name.description: The name that appears at the top of the resume.

contact.description: How an employer reaches you. The email is required: the round-trip gate hard-fails a resume whose contact details do not survive extraction, because a resume nobody can reply to is a silent reject. A flat 'email | phone | location' string is also accepted.

id.description: Short unique id for this job.

dates.description: Human-readable date range, for example '2023 to Present'.

bullets.description: Map from a short bullet id to the bullet text. Keep a deeper pool than any one resume uses.

required_bullets.description: Bullet ids that must always appear for this job.

summaries.description: Map from an archetype name to a summary paragraph.

skills_pool.description: Map from a category name to a comma-separated skills string.

pinned_facts.description: Short statements that must never be contradicted (legal name, work authorization, a consistently-presented title).
